description: This file implements a complex executor mapping system for CU-UP (Control Unit - User Plane) in a wireless communication context, including classes for executor decoration, mapping, and pooling with round-robin distribution, as well as strand-based executor architecture.

classes.name: executor_decorator
classes.description: Helper class to decorate executors with additional functionalities such as tracing, throttling, and metrics.

classes.name: ue_executor_mapper_impl
classes.description: Implementation of the UE executor mapper, managing control, UL, DL, and crypto executors.

classes.name: base_cu_up_executor_pool_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for CU-UP executor pools, including executors, timers, and tracing options.

classes.name: round_robin_cu_up_exec_pool
classes.description: Manages a pool of UE executors with round-robin distribution, supporting creation of UE executor mappers.

classes.name: strand_based_cu_up_executor_mapper
classes.description: Strand-based executor mapper for CU-UP, supporting sequential execution and strand creation for different priorities.

methods.name: decorate
methods.description: Decorates an executor with tracing, throttling, and metrics based on configuration.

methods.name: create_ue_executor_mapper
methods.description: Creates a new UE executor mapper instance.

methods.name: create_strands
methods.description: Creates strand structures and associated executors based on configuration.
